drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, un croquis : une flèche descendant vers « $S$ », un angle droit marqué d'un point, et un segment portant un point
drawings.kind: margin sketch: arrow, right angle with point, segment with point
drawings.notes: In the left margin: an arrow going down from a letter read G to S; to its right a right angle (opening down-right) with a point inside it; below, a slightly curved segment carrying a point. The faint stroke at the top right of the crop belongs to the text and is left out.
drawings.disagreement: The arrow starts from a letter G written above it (read G, like the G of the text), which the transcription does not mention: « une flèche descendant vers S » could read « une flèche G → S ».
